def paint(n: int, ops: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    m = len(ops)
    size = 1 << (m - 1).bit_length()
    values = [0] * (2 * size)
    resets = bytearray(2 * size)

    colours = [0] * m
    events = []
    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
        if op[0] == 1:
            colours[i] = op[3]
        events.append((op[1], i + 1))
        events.append((op[2] + 1, -(i + 1)))
    events.sort()

    counts = {}
    previous = 1

    for position, event in events:
        if position != previous:
            colour = values[1]
            if colour:
                counts[colour] = counts.get(colour, 0) + position - previous
            previous = position

        active = event > 0
        index = abs(event) - 1
        node = size + index
        values[node] = colours[index] if active else 0
        resets[node] = active and colours[index] == 0

        node >>= 1
        while node:
            left = node << 1
            right = left | 1

            reset = resets[left] | resets[right]
            if resets[right]:
                value = values[right]
            else:
                a, b = values[left], values[right]
                value = a if a >= b else b

            if values[node] == value and resets[node] == reset:
                break

            values[node] = value
            resets[node] = reset
            node >>= 1

    return [[colour, counts[colour]] for colour in sorted(counts)]
